answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge every new identity a small, non-refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, so a hollow army of fake accounts becomes a money pit rather than a weapon. Reputation then accrues along a verifiable thread of completed, paid work, each on-chain receipt linking to the next, so trust is earned over time, not claimed at birth. A periodic liveness pulse of proof-of-useful-work challenges then prunes dormant clones, forcing attackers to keep paying compute and stake for every identity they hold.
